source_state: Uncommitted 2.0.0 development working tree; these captures do not claim a published release or deployed production build.
method: Codex in-app browser screenshots of the actual production frontend build, backed by isolated SQLite fixtures and mocked public ESI lookup/waypoint actions.
data: Synthetic pilots/accounts/memberships. Real EVE Image Server logos are visual references only. No production accounts, credentials, private records or live game actions.
cropping: Local Scan is a full viewport capture. Roles and SDE captures are rectangular excerpts of the actual UI; no pixels were repainted or generated.
limitations: Component demonstrations. The SDE fixture has two systems and no completed import, so empty totals and last-run dashes are intentional. Unrelated admin preview services were not all stubbed and are outside the cropped components.
